threads.name: The dragon and the Reeve's bounty
Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve

facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's treasure map.
The party holds a treasure map marking several locations they do not recognize, near Brandonsford.
Where is the treasure the map marks?
Reginald the Frog says a little trickster creature called a Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into Brandonsford every night, up to no good, and that the party should stay away wherever it goes.
What does the Clurichen do when it comes into town each night?
Kill the black dragon troubling Brandonsford and drag its body into town to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
George, a woodsman living a couple of houses from the Clumsy Fox who may come to the tavern tonight, met the dragon and lost an arm to it; the party could question him about the dragon.
Lady Hilda would join the party against the dragon for pay (see her offer's thread).
Where is the black dragon to be found?
Where has this new dragon come from, centuries after Sir Brandon killed the first?
The black dragon, which tore off George the woodsman's arm, is still at large around Brandonsford and may maim others.
Farmer Gill's three sons are hunting the dragon now and could kill it before the party, taking the Reeve's bounty.
Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter in chain mail with a shield, offers to join the party against the dragon for pay.
Sir Phidipaldi told Lady Hilda the party would talk to the Reeve and then come back to take up her services.
Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp in a jar, offers himself and the wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, doing anything as long as he gets to kill people; Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
Why has nothing come into Brandonsford in months, including Bentley's restock shipment that was due a week ago?
Sir Phidipaldi wants to fight Eric the Reeve in the duel he challenged him to at dawn.
Will Eric the Reeve, offended by Sir Phidipaldi, accept his challenge to a duel at dawn?
Get Farmer Gill's mule Shamus, which Gill offers to sell for 100 gold.
When Dunk asked to trade work for Shamus, Farmer Gill said the big work needed is killing the dragon; he did not say outright he would give the mule for it.
Acquire the mithril chain shirt Warwick the smith displays in his shop.
Farmer Gill says Warwick always refuses to sell the mithril chain shirt he displays.
Help Quinn get back at Bentley and collect Quinn's 100 gold.
Quinn's plan: he brings up bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to stage a fake shipment.
What empties or knocks over Quinn's stock every night? Quinn blames Bentley.
